title: Normalized feed model (reader-side parse of feed.xml)
description: The reader parses RSS/Atom into this windowed notification-plane model (spec 7, 13.2). The feed is a lossy signal: it never mutates state; only a fetched item document advances it.

manifest.description: Absolute URL from <blyg:manifest>; the feed's upgrade hook (spec 7).

entries.description: Newest first. One entry per publish event; entries render the item's LATEST content (spec 7).

title.description: Derived; MUST NOT be read back as an item field (spec 7).

legacy.description: True when the source is a plain L0 feed with no blyg: namespace (spec 13.6).

notes: A withdrawn item contributes exactly one entry, title 'withdrawn', empty description (spec 7).
